source: Prospective Devnet wallet-mining V3 acceptance: two distinct complete MaleCNS downstream goals, outside every historical G/S/O population. R2/R4 calibration is preregistered; economic units and total two-FBW budget were finalized on Devnet before goal publication. Cold-start difficulty; no retroactive rewards.

goal.description: Devnet wallet acceptance population 1: 12 prospectively selected downstream cells outside every historical G/S/O population, with two fixed windows and O32 selectivity.
goal.offTargetCoverage: 固定32个按bodyId哈希抽样的非目标细胞；局部评估，不代表全脑选择性。

limits: Complete native event archives checked by independent Python/NumPy predicate evaluator
New disjoint downstream populations outside every historical G/S/O population; kernel/input reuse is explicitly disclosed
Fixed O32 scope, finite held-out sample, development only; not biological validation or a discovered new solution

sampler.selection: 4 disjoint populations of 12 cells sorted by anatomical outgoing stimulus weight, excluding all historical G/S/O populations; first two eligible groups selected only after preregistered calibration
